entities.summary: Sharaf al-Zamān Ṭāhir al-Marvazī, also known as Sharaf al-Zaman al-Marwazi, was a renowned physician and author of the seminal work “Nature of Animals”, published in 1125 CE. Born in what is now Iran, al-Marwazī's contributions to the field of zoology and medicine were groundbreaking, reflecting the sophisticated intellectual and scientific achievements of the Islamic Golden Age. His work had a lasting impact on the development of veterinary medicine and animal husbandry, influencing scholars and practitioners across the Middle East, North Africa, and Europe for centuries to come.
